newsitem.title: USA: Utah Medical says files suit vs Graphic.
newsitem.headline: Utah Medical says files suit vs Graphic.

text.p: Utah Medical Products Inc said Wednesday that it had filed a patent infringement lawsuit in the United States District Court for the Central District of Utah against Graphic Controls Corp.

The company said the suit alleges that Graphic Controls' Softrans 4000 Intrauterine Pressure Catheter infringes Utah Medical's United States patent for inventions relating to a "Disposable Intracompartmental Pressure Transducer."

The complaint also alleges that Graphic Controls has violated the Lanham Act by adopting a product description that trades off the good will developed by Utah Medical's INTRAN 400 product and by representing that its IUP 4000 SOFTRANS catheter is the same as INTRAN.

The company said the complaint further claims that Graphic Controls has engaged in acts of unfair competition with Utah Medical, and seeks recovery of compensatory and punitive damages and an injunction against the defendents.

Utah Medical said that on May 23, the United States District Court for the Western District of New York ruled in favor of the company against Graphic Controls by dismissing, for lack of jurisdiction, a lawsuit filed by Graphic Controls.
The lawsuit sought to obtain a declaratory judgment of "patent invalidity and non-infringement and for absence of unfair competition" relative to Utah Medical's INTRAN product, the company said.
It said its subsequent patent infringement suit against Graphic Controls was filed on June 3.
